title: Plenums and air ducts.
officialText:
A plenum supplied as a part of the air-conditioning appliance shall be installed in accordance with the
appliance manufacturer’s instructions. Where a plenum is not supplied with the appliance, such plenum shall be installed in
accordance with the fabrication and installation instructions provided by the plenum and appliance manufacturer. The method of
connecting supply and return ducts shall facilitate proper circulation of air.
Where an air-conditioning appliance is installed within a space separated from the spaces served by the appliance, the air circulated
by the appliance shall be conveyed by ducts that are sealed to the casing of the appliance and that separate the circulating air from the
combustion and ventilation air.
